verdicts.one_liner: Untouched gun core; one bad lane softened, one sharpened — net flat.
verdicts.indirect: Celeste's silence/slow/range cuts (Dazzling Trick +1.25s->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30m->25m) ease a listed losing lane, but Ivy — also a loss for Wraith — benefits from Healbane's stacked cut dropping 82.2%->72%, so her sustain is harder to suppress. The two roughly cancel; nothing touches fire-rate M1 or her core items.

verdicts.one_liner: No changes to him; his two worst fronts got slightly worse to fight.
verdicts.indirect: Mo & Krill — a listed loss who tanks the cage — took Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP 40->50, and the weaker stacked anti-heal makes Ivy's 48% sustain matchup harder to grind down. Both are small; his late-gun clock problem is unchanged.
